research_findings: Analyzed the ultimate-sd application codebase and identified a missing implementation for rate limiting on the joinWaitlist server action.
Identified that the Upstash rate limit libraries (@upstash/ratelimit, @upstash/redis) were missing from the package.json despite being referenced in the lockfile.
features_improved: Enhanced the waitlist feature by preventing abuse through IP-based rate limiting.
Optimized waitlist actions by removing deprecated TODOs and structuring rate-limit validation cleanly.
new_features_added: Introduced a global RateLimiter service `src/lib/rate-limit.ts` powered by Upstash and Redis.
Added @upstash/ratelimit and @upstash/redis dependencies to the project.
Added rate limiting to the joinWaitlist Server Action via the Next.js headers function for real-world production setups.
next_steps_for_next_run: Implement comprehensive unit tests for the ratelimit module to verify bypassing logic when environment variables are omitted.
Research additional API endpoints in the system that could benefit from rate limiting (e.g. feedback submissions or contact forms) and expand the usage of the new `ratelimit` utility.
